scripts.build:ctl: swiftc -O -framework CoreGraphics -framework IOKit -F /System/Library/PrivateFrameworks -framework DisplayServices macos/lumabridge-ctl.swift -o macos/lumabridge-ctl
scripts.build:daemon: swiftc -O -framework Cocoa -framework IOKit -framework CoreGraphics -F /System/Library/PrivateFrameworks -framework DisplayServices macos/LumaBridgeDaemon.swift -o macos/lumabridged
scripts.build:app: mkdir -p LumaBridge.app/Contents/MacOS LumaBridge.app/Contents/Resources && cp macos/Info.plist LumaBridge.app/Contents/Info.plist && swiftc -O -framework Cocoa -framework WebKit macos/LumaBridgeApp.swift -o LumaBridge.app/Contents/MacOS/LumaBridge
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:ctl && npm run build:daemon && npm run build:app
